description: Search Pakeesim's live catalogue of prepaid travel data eSIMs (prices in IDR, live sale prices and availability). Use it when the user asks for eSIM or travel data plans for a destination. `tujuan` is free text in any language: a country, city or region, optionally with days and data ("Japan 7 days 3GB", "eSIM Jepang seminggu", "日本 5日間", "eSIM Europa 15 días", "유럽 2주"). Returns `saran` (cheapest available plan covering the stated days/data), then plans in recommended order: the country's own plans, then regional and Global plans that also cover it. Without `tujuan` and filters: one line per destination with plan count and lowest price.

bahasa.description: Label language: id (Indonesian, default) or en.

hargaMaksIdr.description: Only plans at or below this price (IDR).

kuotaMinGb.description: Only plans with at least this much data (GB).

masaAktifMinHari.description: Only plans valid for at least this many days.

tujuan.description: Destination and needs in the user's own words, any language.

name: cari_paket

hargaIdr.description: Final price the user pays now, any sale included. Present this as the price.

hargaNormalIdr.description: Normal price before the sale, shown struck through next to the final price. Not what the user pays.

hematIdr.description: Saving per eSIM in IDR (normal price minus final price). A saving, never the price.

hematPersen.description: Saving versus the normal price, in percent.

labelHarga.description: Ready-to-show price line: final price, normal price, saving in % and IDR, and when the sale ends (WIB, UTC+7).

title: Search eSIM plans
